The '''Finance Committee''' was the committee of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] and [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senates]] that oversaw the budget of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], it was chaired by a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Senator.
